main.description: Reserve a World on the configured tenor as the signed-in owner. Sign the returned operation on the owner's device; never send its private key.

rotationKey.description: The owner's public P-256 or K-256 did:key.

operation.description: Unsigned PLC genesis. Add only its sig field before finishing.

signingBytes.description: Unpadded base64url canonical DAG-CBOR bytes. Sign with ECDSA SHA-256 as compact low-S r || s.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The signed-in owner cannot reserve a World.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The PDS or tenor could not complete the request.
